changelog:
Initial release of the dispatching-parallel-agents skill.

- Enables delegating independent tasks to parallel agents without shared context.
- Documents the pattern for grouping unrelated failures and launching specialized agents concurrently.
- Provides guidance on crafting focused, self-contained agent prompts with clear constraints.
- Clarifies when to use (and not use) parallel agent dispatch based on task independence and shared state.
- Includes real-world examples, step-by-step workflow, and common mistakes to avoid.
summary: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
